product_one_liner.value: Speak_ is an AI resume-screening platform that helps recruiters and hiring teams evaluate applicants against customizable hiring criteria.

pricing_page.notes: Public plans and pricing are published in a section of the homepage.

named_customers.notes: Both organizations are identified in customer testimonials.

employee_band.notes: Based on the listed employee count of 18; separate company-size metadata is inconsistent.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains recruiting, interviewing, career and marketing content, not posts explaining how Speak_ is built.

public_docs.notes: The homepage provides an FAQ, and linked documentation is a single Ashby setup guide; no public multi-article product documentation portal was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The company job board says Speak_ has not added any jobs.

model_provider.notes: The company describes using 'internal proprietary models and open AI solutions' but does not unambiguously name a specific model or provider in the reviewed interview, documentation, FAQ or privacy materials.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy names GDPR/UK GDPR and claims compliance with relevant data-protection regulations. This is a compliance claim, not evidence of an independently audited certification.

last_funding.notes: CB Insights identifies its latest round as a $0.12 million seed round on March 5, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The reported latest round, March 5, 2025, predates the May 9, 2025 start of the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The company job board says Speak_ has not added any jobs.

launched_6mo.notes: No dated qualifying launch was found for May 9–November 9, 2026. The latest dated product launch located was February 2024; the feature-update pages are undated.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A qualifying C-level or VP change could not be verified. The company page names Andrea Guendelman as CEO, while her profile records a founder-to-board transition in 2026 without explicitly dating her CEO tenure.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The homepage links to a Rewardful-powered affiliate program. That program now reports it is inactive, so this is a historical affiliate-marketing signal, not confirmation of an active CRM deployment.
